'''Satsuki Yukino''' (Japanese: '''雪野五月''' ''Yukino Satsuki'', born May 25, 1970), formerly spelled with different kanji as 雪乃五月, is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Yukino has been providing voices for Pokémon since the [[original series]]. She had voiced mostly [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] until {{aniseries|DP}}, when Yukino took over all of [[Tomoko Kawakami]]'s roles, most notably those of [[Marian]], [[Dawn's Buneary]] and [[Sinnoh Pokédex]], during her 20-month-long sick leave and after she died from {{wp|ovarian cancer}}.
